subject: Mudryk dump truck
title: Mudryk: what 100 million euros feels like

lines.vo: What does a hundred-million-euro transfer feel like? A dump truck.
That is Mykhailo Mudryk's answer. Shakhtar to Chelsea, January twenty twenty-three.
Seventy million euros up front. Up to a hundred with add-ons. The most expensive Ukrainian footballer ever.
The salary? Reports said four hundred thousand pounds a month.
Gross. As in, before tax. So how big is the tax? Forty-five percent.
A hundred-million price tag. Forty-five percent tax. At thirty-seven point four kilometres an hour, he can outrun everything except the taxman.
